tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Maxsun Challenger B760M-N D5 DDR5 LGA1700 Motherboard – Intel 12th/13th Gen, Micro ATX

The Maxsun Challenger B760M-N D5 is a compact, high-performance motherboard designed for Intel’s 12th and 13th Gen processors. Powered by the Intel B760 chipset and LGA1700 socket, it supports DDR5 memory up to 96GB and 6000MHz (OC), ensuring blazing-fast performance for gaming and multitasking. This Micro ATX board combines reliability, value, and essential features in a sleek, modern design.


Key Features:

  • Chipset: Intel B760
  • CPU Socket: LGA1700 – Supports Intel 12th/13th Gen Core, Pentium Gold, Celeron
  • Form Factor: Micro ATX (245mm x 190mm)
  • Memory Support:
  • 2 x DDR5 DIMM slots
  • Up to 96GB capacity 4800/5000/5200/5400/5600/5800/6000 MHz (OC)
  • Intel XMP 3.0 ready
  • Expansion Slots:
  • 1 x PCIe 4.0 x16
  • 1 x PCIe 3.0 x4
  • Storage Options:
  • 2 x M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4
  • 3 x SATA 6Gb/s
  • Graphics Outputs:
  • 1 x HDMI 2.0 (up to 4K@30Hz)
  • 1 x VGA (up to 2048×1536@50Hz)
  • Networking:
  • Realtek RTL8111H 1Gb Ethernet
  • Audio:
  • Realtek ALC897 5.1-Channel HD Audio
  • USB Ports:
  • Rear: 4 x USB 3.2 Gen1, 2 x USB 2.0
  • Front: 2 x USB 3.2 Gen1, 4 x USB 2.0
  • Internal I/O:
  • 24-pin ATX power connector
  • 8-pin CPU power connector
  • 2 x M.2 slots
  • 3 x SATA ports
  • CPU + system fan headers
  • 1 x 12V RGB header
  • TPM 2.0 header
  • Operating System: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
